answer: WITH s AS (SELECT p.sitelabel, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::float AS pn, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::float AS pl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.sitekey ORDER BY r.snapts DESC) AS rn FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::float + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::float <> 0) SELECT sitelabel, ROUND((pn * (1 - pl / (pn + pl)))::numeric, 2) AS effective_power_w FROM s WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY effective_power_w DESC

SELECT LOWER(pm.pnlkind) AS panel_kind, AVG(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::float - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::float) / (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::float) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::float > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(pm.pnlkind) ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC
SELECT SUM((pm.degyrrate / 100.0) * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss FROM plants p JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE pm.degyrrate * 20 > 14
note: ADR taken as the panel model specified annual degradation (degyrrate, percent), one term per plant.

answer: WITH s AS (SELECT o.maintcost, o.mtbfh, o.mttrh, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600.0 AS total_hours FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie WHERE o.mtbfh > 0) SELECT AVG(maintcost / (total_hours / mtbfh)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost FROM s WHERE total_hours > 0 AND mttrh / (mtbfh + mttrh) > 0.05
note: Offline >5% read as System Unavailability MTTR/(MTBF+MTTR) > 0.05; max in data is 0.04, so result is NULL.

answer: SELECT sitelabel, warrclaims FROM plants WHERE LOWER(warrstate) = 'claimed' AND warrclaims > 2 ORDER BY warrclaims DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.sitetie) AS plant_count FROM mechanical_condition m JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = m.snapmk WHERE LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status') = 'failed' OR LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status') <> 'normal'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.maintcost / (17520.0 / o.mtbfh))::numeric, 0) AS mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE LOWER(pm.pnlkind) = 'hjt' AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count FROM electrical_performance e WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::float > 15
note: More than 30 of 200 W = soil_loss_pct > 15; max in data 14.99, so 0.

answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sitekey) AS plant_count FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN environmental_conditions c ON c.snapref = r.snapkey JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh') IS NOT NULL AND p.cap_mw > 0 AND (c.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'poa_irr_w_m2')::float > 0 AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh) > 0 AND ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::float / (p.cap_mw * 1000)) / ((c.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'poa_irr_w_m2')::float / 1000.0) < 0.75 AND (1 - o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh)) < 0.95
note: Uses knowledge-base formula PR and MTTR/MTBF availability; no row has availability < 0.95, so 0.

answer: SELECT (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::float * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::float / ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::float + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::float)) AS effective_power_w FROM electrical_performance e WHERE UPPER(e.snaplink) = 'PV945724'
